Interface PersistentContainerKey

All Known Implementing Classes:
PersistentContainerKey.BlockEntityKey, PersistentContainerKey.EnderChest, PersistentContainerKey.EntityKey, PersistentContainerKey.Modded, PersistentContainerKey.PlayerInventory
public sealed interface PersistentContainerKey permits PersistentContainerKey.PlayerInventory, PersistentContainerKey.EnderChest, PersistentContainerKey.BlockEntityKey, PersistentContainerKey.EntityKey, PersistentContainerKey.Modded
Persistent identity for a Container — the owner a slot's state attaches to, in a form that survives session boundaries.

SlotIdentity provides session-scoped identity via the container reference. PersistentContainerKey is the across-session counterpart: each variant names a stable owner (player UUID, block position + dimension, entity UUID, or a mod-defined scope) that the library uses to look up the slot's state in a Fabric attachment on the natural owner class.

See menukit/Design Docs/Phase 12/M1_PER_SLOT_STATE.md §4.1 for the resolution table and rationale.
